 Order

Aggrieved by the compensation granted for the lands of the petitioner acquired for the purpose of expansion of National Highways No.45A (Villupuram  Puducherry  Cuddalore  Nagapattinam Division), the petitioner had filed claim petition before the 1st respondent on 19.02.2024 and 01.07.2024.

entities.text: National Highways No.45A (Villupuram  Puducherry  Cuddalore  Nagapattinam Division
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: However, to date the claim petition has not been taken up for consideration and aggrieved by the same, the petitioner is before this Court.

2. Heard the learned counsels on the either side and perused the records.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 3.
It is an admitted fact that the petitioner's lands have been acquired and the petitioner has filed a claim petition seeking enhanced compensation.
However, the petitioner's claim petition has not been taken up for hearing by the 1st respondent.
The 1st respondent is a statutory authority appointed under the Act as an Arbitrator to consider the petitions arising in respect of enhanced compensation.
The 1st respondent has failed to dispose of the same.
4. Therefore, a mandamus is issued directing the 1st respondent to dispose of the claim petition filed by petitioner, within a period of 4 months, from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
5. Accordingly, the Writ Petition is allowed.
No costs.
